LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.familyEntropyOf_m: Take finite-valued variables Xᵢ on a common source, and write X[S] for the tuple selected by S. If S ⊆ T are finite index sets, H(X[S]) ≤ H(X[T]).

LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.familyEntropy_uni: Let Xᵢ be the finite-valued coordinates of a random vector with law q, and write X[S] for the tuple selected by S. The joint entropy of the coordinates in A ∪ B is at most H(X[A]) + H(X[B]) for finite index sets A,B.

LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.familyEntropy_le_: Let Xᵢ be the finite-valued coordinates of a random vector with law q. For every finite set S, the joint entropy of the coordinates in S is at most the sum of their individual entropies.

LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.familyEntropy_sub: Let Xᵢ be the finite-valued coordinates of a random vector with law q. For an ordered list of distinct indices, the joint entropy of its coordinates is at most the sum of their individual entropies over positions in the list.
